description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing tags in the admin interface of the Goteo application. It handles actions such as listing, adding, editing, removing, and translating tags, including permission checks and form processing.

classes.name: TagsSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing tag-related actions in the admin section, including authorization and CRUD operations.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the user is authorized (superadmin or root) and if the node is the master node.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles the translation process for a tag, delegating to the 'process' method.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing a tag, including form submission and validation.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles adding a new tag through a form.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that processes add, edit, remove, list, and translate actions for tags.
